name: Singapore
dek: Changi Airport, WMO 48698. The only Singapore file.
paragraphs: The only station in the Singapore submission is Changi Airport, WMO 48698, height 14 m, at the eastern end of the island. No official driving-side or tipping source for Singapore was found on this pass, so those lines are missing.

The highest average high in the table is 32.4 °C, in April. The lowest average low is 24.3 °C, in January and December. The wettest month by the precipitation column is December, at 332.1 mm, and the driest is February, at 105.0 mm.

climate.caption: Reference station: Changi Airport, WMO 48698.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.
climate.sourceTitle: WMO climate normals 1991-2020, Singapore Changi Airport (48698)

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C, G and M, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Singapore at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Singapore, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Singapore Dollar and the code SGD for Singapore.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives Singapore one row, Asia/Singapore. zone1970.tab lists that zone on a row it shares with Antarctica and peninsular Malaysia; the zone name is the same in both files.
